userStory: Create and validate an Aomi app.
smokePrompt: List the app capabilities in one paragraph.

phases.brief: Investigate Uniswap v3 LP mechanics on Ethereum: NonfungiblePositionManager (mint/increaseLiquidity/decreaseLiquidity/collect), pool contracts, fee tiers, tick math, and read paths for position state (positions(), slot0, tick ranges). Map the pool-data surfaces the manager needs (pool discovery, TVL/volume/fees, yields, trending) onto the existing SDK apps: apps/geckoterminal (DEX pool analytics/trending), apps/defillama (TVL, yields, pool APYs), and apps/dune (custom onchain queries) — kaito is excluded. Note any gaps those three don't cover. Write apps/lp-manager/research.md.

phases.question: Which news/insight data API should lp-manager wrap for market context?

options.label: CryptoPanic (recommended)
options.summary: Free crypto news aggregation API with currency filters — draft an OpenAPI spec from its docs.

options.label: CoinGecko
options.summary: Broader market data + trending/news endpoints; has a published API surface.

options.label: No new news client
options.summary: Skip a news API; rely on geckoterminal/defillama/dune pool data for insight.

phases.brief: Draft apps/lp-manager/openapi.yaml for the news/insight API chosen in the clarify step, covering headline feeds, per-token/currency filtering, and trending/insight endpoints. Skip if 'no new news client' was chosen.
Curate user-centric tools from the generated news/insight client (e.g. get_pool_news, market_sentiment_for_token) rather than one tool per endpoint.

Turn research.md into preambles and on-chain building blocks: contract-call tool flows for opening, adjusting, harvesting, and closing Uniswap v3 LP positions, wired together with the news/insight tools and the existing geckoterminal (pool analytics/trending), defillama (TVL/yields/APYs), and dune (custom queries) apps so the agent can discover pools, compare yields, and manage positions with market context.
